subject.title: Feature: Handle Signal message edits (editMessage envelope)

question: What should a Signal edit do to authoritative session context and an already-running agent turn?
rationale: Source inspection establishes the missing transport relationship, but code alone cannot choose whether edits replace history, append corrections, wake a new turn, or steer/cancel an active turn.

options.title: Structured correction event
options.body: Map the edit to its original message, preserve an explicit edited marker or metadata, and suppress a new group response unless the corrected text mentions the agent.

options.title: Replace and restart
options.body: Replace the original transcript content and cancel or restart any active turn that was based on the stale text.

options.title: Keep current semantics
options.body: Continue treating edits as new messages and close the request as unsupported behavior.

recommendation.title: Structured correction event
recommendation.body: Map the edit to its original message, preserve an explicit edited marker or metadata, and suppress a new group response unless the corrected text mentions the agent.

likelyOwner.reason: The current behavior and requested policy meet in the Signal inbound routing and dispatch path most strongly associated with this owner history.
